Sabah Futbol Klubu is a professional football club based in Masazir, Azerbaijan. The team has played in the Azerbaijan Premier League, the top tier of Azerbaijani football league system, since the 2018–19 season. Its home ground is the Bank Respublika Arena in Masazir.
